verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents official support for ChatGPT, Claude, and AI agents through MCP, plus CLI access and skills for agents. That lets users drive Basecamp with natural language, but only through an external assistant; there is no evidence of a native in-app natural-language command interface. missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command surface inside Basecamp, documentation of which operations can be done via natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Official Basecamp support for ChatGPT, Claude, and AI agents with full MCP support.
CLI access and skills for AI agents you run on your computer.
